title: OpenAI just bought a slide deck startup. It is assembling an office suite one acqui-hire at a time.
excerpt: OpenAI acquired presentation startup NextSlide after about a year of life. The product it replaces is PowerPoint, which belongs to its biggest investor.
content_html:
OpenAI has acquired NextSlide, a startup that turned prompts, notes, documents, and research into finished editable presentations. Financial terms were not disclosed, and the team has moved onto ChatGPT.

Founder Ahmed Beshry announced the deal in a note on the company’s website, which now carries nothing else. “The NextSlide team is now at OpenAI, helping build ChatGPT,” he wrote.

A very short round trip

NextSlide was founded in mid-2025, making it roughly a year old at exit. That is a compressed path even by current standards, and it says more about OpenAI’s appetite than about the product.

It is Beshry’s second exit. He co-founded Caper AI, the smart-cart and cashierless checkout company, which Instacart acquired in October 2021 with carts already running in Kroger, Wakefern, and Sobeys stores.

The shopping list

This is not an isolated purchase. OpenAI paid $6.5 billion for io, Jony Ive’s hardware startup, and $1.1 billion for analytics firm Statsig, while quietly absorbing smaller teams including personal finance apps Hiro and Roi.

The pattern is consistent: a small team, a working product, and a destination inside ChatGPT rather than a brand that survives. Most of these are recruitment exercises with a product attached.

What it is actually building

Presentations are not a random gap to fill. Documents, canvas, file handling, and now decks are the components of an office suite, and OpenAI has been assembling them steadily.

ChatGPT Work is the clearest statement of intent, an agent that takes action across a user’s apps and files and stays with a project for hours rather than answering a single question.

The traction is real. OpenAI’s agents have passed 10 million users as the company pushes to turn a consumer habit into software that finance, sales, and operations teams pay to keep running.

The awkward part

The product NextSlide was built to replace is PowerPoint. Microsoft is OpenAI’s largest backer and has built OpenAI’s technology into Office, Windows, and Bing, which makes every step into productivity software a step onto its investor’s lawn.

Regulators have already noticed the entanglement. The EU joined the UK in scrutinising the OpenAI-Microsoft relationship, and a partner that competes with you in your core market is a harder thing to explain than a partner that merely funds you.

Everyone is building the same thing

Google is running the identical play from the other direction. Gemini Spark launched at I/O as an always-on assistant taking instructions through Gmail, tying Google’s existing products together rather than acquiring new ones.

That is the structural difference. Google already owns the productivity surfaces and is adding intelligence, while OpenAI owns the intelligence and is buying the surfaces.

Which approach wins depends on whether people would rather have AI added to the tools they already use, or replace those tools with something built around AI from the start. NextSlide is a small bet on the second answer.

content_html_zh:
OpenAI 收购了 NextSlide，这是一家将提示、笔记、文档和研究转化为可编辑演示文稿的初创公司。 财务条款尚未披露，团队已转向 ChatGPT。

创始人艾哈迈德·贝什里 (Ahmed Beshry) 在公司网站上的一份说明中宣布了这项交易，该网站目前没有其他内容。 “NextSlide 团队现在在 OpenAI，帮助构建 ChatGPT，”他写道。

非常短的往返行程

NextSlide 成立于 2025 年中期，退出时大约一年了。 即使按照当前标准，这也是一条压缩路径，它更多地体现了 OpenAI 的兴趣，而不是产品。

这是贝什里的第二个出口。 他与人共同创立了 Caper AI，这是一家智能购物车和无现金结账公司，Instacart 于 2021 年 10 月收购了该公司，该公司的购物车已在 Kroger、Wakefern 和 Sobeys 商店中运行。

购物清单

这不是一次孤立的购买。 OpenAI 斥资 65 亿美元收购了 Jony Ive 的硬件初创公司 io，并斥资 11 亿美元收购了分析公司 Statsig，同时悄悄吸收了包括个人理财应用 Hiro 和 Roi 在内的小型团队。

模式是一致的：一个小团队，一个工作产品，以及 ChatGPT 内部的一个目的地，而不是一个生存的品牌。 其中大多数都是附带产品的招聘活动。

它实际上正在构建什么

演示不是随意填补的空白。 文档、画布、文件处理以及现在的幻灯片都是办公套件的组成部分，OpenAI 一直在稳步地组装它们。

ChatGPT Work 是最明确的意图声明，它是一个代理，它对用户的应用程序和文件采取行动，并在一个项目上停留几个小时，而不是回答一个问题。

牵引力是真实的。 OpenAI 的代理用户数量已超过 1000 万，该公司致力于将消费者习惯转变为财务、销售和运营团队付费维持运行的软件。

尴尬的部分

NextSlide 旨在取代 PowerPoint。 微软是 OpenAI 最大的支持者，并将 OpenAI 的技术内置到 Office、Windows 和 Bing 中，这使得生产力软件的每一步都踏上了投资者的草坪。

监管机构已经注意到了这种纠缠。 欧盟与英国一起审查 OpenAI 与微软的关系，在核心市场与你竞争的合作伙伴比仅仅为你提供资金的合作伙伴更难解释。

每个人都在构建同样的东西

谷歌正在从另一个方向进行同样的游戏。 Gemini Spark 在 I/O 大会上推出，作为一个永远在线的助手，通过 Gmail 接受指令，将 Google 的现有产品捆绑在一起，而不是购买新产品。

这就是结构性差异。 谷歌已经拥有生产力界面并正在添加智能，而 OpenAI 拥有智能并正在购买这些界面。

哪种方法获胜取决于人们是否愿意将人工智能添加到他们已经使用的工具中，或者从一开始就用围绕人工智能构建的工具替换这些工具。 NextSlide 是对第二个答案的一个小赌注。
